customMfg.heroDescription: Every Hindu temple possesses unique sanctum proportions and Agama guidelines. At Sri Shakthi Vinayaga Metals in Tirupur, we manufacture bespoke sacred metalware engineered specifically to your temple's dimensional requirements.
customMfg.pillar1Desc: Fabricated to match exact idol height, shoulder width, and pedestal slots from 2 feet to 12 feet in Makara or peacock torana styles.
customMfg.pillar2Desc: From 18 inches to over 6 feet in height for Raja Gopurams and Vimanams with internal grain chambers and lightning earthing collar.
customMfg.pillar3Desc: Interlocking segmented heavy-gauge brass cylinders, stepped lotus pedestals, and Ashtalakshmi Bali Peedam coverings.
customMfg.pillar4Desc: Monolithic bell metal casting with Nandi, Garuda, or Hanuman finials, producing deep long-sustaining Omkara acoustic resonance.

about.heroSubtitle: Sacred Metallurgy for Generations of Temples
about.heroDescription: Leading South Indian temple metalware foundry based in Tirupur, Tamil Nadu. Dedicated to traditional Shilpa Shastra proportions, we manufacture masterfully carved Prabavalayam arches, monumental Gopuram Kalasams, Kodimaram flag poles, and temple bells.
about.storyParagraph1: Sri Shakthi Vinayaga Metals was founded in Tirupur with a sacred commitment to preserve the venerable traditions of South Indian temple metal craftsmanship. From sanctum sanctorum deity prabhavalis to soaring Raja Gopuram pinnacles, we fabricate sacred artifacts with uncompromised metallurgical purity.
about.storyParagraph2: Engineered to endure decades of extreme tropical monsoon weather, holy abhishekam liquids, and ceremonial camphor smoke, every piece reflects timeless balance, spiritual authority, and structural durability.
about.principle1Desc: Strict adherence to canonical proportions and Agama sacred iconometry.
about.principle2Desc: Certified virgin brass, 99.9% electrolytic copper, and acoustic bell bronze.
about.principle3Desc: Custom sizing made to order for every sanctum and deity throne.
about.principle4Desc: Transparent manufacturer pricing without middleman markups.
about.foundryLocationSubtitle: Industrial Metal Estate, Tirupur, Tamil Nadu
about.foundryLocationDesc: Supplying temples, trusts, sthapatis, and devotees across India and globally.
about.highlightsTitle: Why Temples Trust Sri Shakthi Vinayaga Metals
about.blessingSubtitle: May auspicious vibrations illuminate your sacred projects.
about.heroMainDesc: We create traditional temple metalwork with attention to craftsmanship, quality, and the sacred purpose of every project.
about.heroSecondaryDesc: Crafting divine traditions in metal with sacred devotion and enduring legacy.
about.companyText: Sri Shakthi Vinayaga Metals is a temple metalware manufacturer based in Tirupur, Tamil Nadu. We work with customers on Prabavalayam, Kalasam, Kodimaram, Temple Bells, and other temple requirements, providing product details and quotations based on their needs.
about.companyTextEn: We specialize in manufacturing high-quality traditional metal products for temples, mutts, and spiritual institutions using brass, copper, and silver finish, combining legacy craftsmanship with lasting durability.
about.craftsmanshipText: Our products are crafted by experienced artisans following traditional South Indian metal sculpting techniques passed down through generations. Every piece is carefully handmade with precision, devotion, and attention to detail.
about.craftsmanshipTextEn: Our craftsmanship brings together traditional metalworking techniques, intricate detailing, and careful finishing to create products suited to each customer's requirements.
about.val1Desc: Supporting temple projects with respect for tradition.
about.val2Desc: Material selection based on the confirmed product requirements.
about.val3Desc: Attention to detail in traditional metalwork.
about.val4Desc: Discuss product requirements and quotations directly with our team.
about.ctaEyebrow: Trusted Partner for Sacred Temple Projects
about.ctaDesc: Share your temple project requirements, preferred dimensions, and product specifications with our team.
about.ctaDescEn: We provide detailed technical advice, material specifications, and fair foundry quotations.
about.craftsmanshipText2: Strictly adhering to sacred Agamic proportions, our artisans employ traditional techniques like repoussé relief work and intricate hand-chasing, ensuring every Prabavalayam, Kalasam, and sacred artifact is resilient and consecrated for generations of worship.
about.craftsmanshipText2En: Strictly adhering to sacred Agamic proportions, our artisans employ traditional techniques like repoussé relief work and intricate hand-chasing, ensuring every Prabavalayam, Kalasam, and sacred artifact is resilient and consecrated for generations of worship.
about.craftsmanshipPillar1Desc: Hand-engraved floral, Yali, and sacred temple motifs sculpted using specialized steel chisels.
about.craftsmanshipPillar2Desc: Every arch, pinnacle, and cavity strictly aligned with temple sanctum requirements.
about.craftsmanshipPillar3Desc: Fabricated from pure metals to endure ceremonial abhishekam, smoke, and outdoor elements.
